commitments.description: Make 100% of packaging reusable, recyclable, or compostable by 2025.
Use 12% recycled or renewable plastic in packaging by 2025.

controversies.description: Kinder Surprise plastic egg-halves are individually wrapped and frequently appear in litter audits.

wooby.headline: Ferrero makes Nutella and Kinder — and tiny plastic toy capsules.
wooby.narrative: Ferrero makes Nutella, Kinder eggs, and Tic Tacs. Wooby has spotted Kinder egg halves on Italian beaches — they look like little white cups. Ferrero is changing some of them to paper. Wooby is hopeful.
